{"type":"deployment","sha":"126429e44560bcf6321d02d9e3d18ce3ddfb2180","repoName":"barakuziel-vxt/vxt","actor":"barakuziel-vxt","slotName":"production","commitMessage":"fix: Prevent web app deployment from triggering on documentation changes

Updated deploy-python-code.yml to ignore:
- All files in azure-functions/ (function app specific)
- All markdown files in docs/
- All root-level markdown files (*.md)

This ensures the web app workflow only triggers when actual application code changes,
not when documentation or function app configuration is updated.

Previously, changes to docs/DEPLOYMENT_STATUS.md would incorrectly trigger the web app
deployment workflow instead of (or in addition to) the function app deployment."}
